mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_execution_task ( id, session_id, user_id, agent_id, user_message_id, sequence_no, status ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{userId}, #{agentId}, CAST(#{userMessageId} AS uuid), #{sequenceNo}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT task.id, task.session_id, task.user_id, task.agent_id, task.user_message_id, task.sequence_no, task.status, task.attempt_count, task.created_at FROM agent_execution_task task WHERE task.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_task earlier WHERE earlier.session_id = task.session_id AND earlier.sequence_no < task.sequence_no AND earlier.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ) ORDER BY task.created_at, task.id LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE agent_execution_task task SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = task.attempt_count + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failure_type = NULL WHERE task.id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND task.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_task earlier WHERE earlier.session_id = task.session_id AND earlier.sequence_no < task.sequence_no AND earlier.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ) RETURNING task.id, task.session_id, task.user_id, task.agent_id, task.user_message_id, task.sequence_no, task.status, task.attempt_count, task.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_execution_task SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = GREATEST(attempt_count - 1, 0), started_at = NULL WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_execution_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_execution_task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_type = #{failureType}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING'
